raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-BGD-SocialProtectionResilience",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Political transition and mass uprising create macro‑economic uncertainty that could undermine project financing and implementation.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain close liaison with the interim government; embed flexible financing clauses and monitor macro‑economic indicators quarterly.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context: interim government sworn in after mass uprising; downside risks and uncertainty remain (p.1)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "High inflation erodes real value of cash‑transfer benefits, risking inadequate support for beneficiaries.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement the benefit‑adequacy framework with index‑linking to CPI or HIES data; adjust transfers annually.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context: inflation at 9.9% Jan 2025; benefit adequacy risks noted (p.4‑5)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Limited foreign‑exchange reserves increase vulnerability to currency shocks that could affect disbursement timing.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Secure multi‑year drawdown schedule; hold a portion of IDA funds in local currency; monitor FX reserves monthly.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context: FX reserves at US$19.9 bn (~3.3 months imports) (p.1)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Delay in establishing the Dynamic Social Registry (DSR) units, steering committee and guidelines could stall rollout.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Set firm milestones in the Project Operations Manual; conduct monthly progress reviews; allocate dedicated staff with clear TORs.",
      "evidence": "Legal Covenants: requirement to establish DSR units and steering committee within 2‑6 months (p.6‑7)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Poor data quality from legacy National Household Database may lead to inaccurate targeting.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct data‑validation workshops; integrate field verification; use proxy‑means testing calibrated to recent HIES data.",
      "evidence": "Sectoral Context: past NHD pilot failed due to incomplete/outdated data (p.5‑6)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Insufficient staffing and capacity in DSS and FD PIUs to manage complex MIS and DSR operations.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit certified FM and technical staff; provide intensive training; embed performance‑based incentives.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary: need for additional capacity, training, and close monitoring (p.21)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Targeting errors (exclusion/inclusion) may persist despite DSR, reducing program effectiveness.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply periodic benefit‑adequacy and targeting audits; refine proxy‑means thresholds; use grievance redress data for correction.",
      "evidence": "Sectoral Context: inclusion errors remain high; need for digitized tools (p.7‑8)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Climate‑induced floods or cyclones could disrupt beneficiary access and MIS operations.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Leverage disaster‑resilient data centers; pre‑position mobile cash‑out points; integrate climate‑risk layers into DSR targeting.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context: Bangladesh ranks 7th in Climate Risk Index; floods affect >1 million annually (p.2‑3)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Physical damage to servers despite disaster‑recovery centers could interrupt MIS and cash‑transfer processing.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain off‑site backups; conduct quarterly DR drills; ensure redundant power and connectivity at data centers.",
      "evidence": "Project Description: MIS housed in National Data Centers with disaster recovery (p.16‑17)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Complex financing and procurement arrangements increase risk of misallocation or audit findings.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement iBAS++ for transparent budgeting; conduct annual internal audits; train staff on World Bank procurement rules.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary: detailed financial management and audit arrangements (p.21‑24)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Failure to meet Performance‑Based Conditions (PBCs) could delay disbursements and affect project timelines.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a PBC tracking unit; conduct quarterly verification; build buffer funds to cover interim cash‑flow needs.",
      "evidence": "Key Risks & PBC tables: disbursement linked to achievement of targets (p.24‑30)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Ineffective Grievance Redress Mechanism may lead to beneficiary dissatisfaction and social unrest.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen GRM with mobile hotlines; set SLA for response; publish quarterly complaint resolution reports.",
      "evidence": "GRM section and stakeholder engagement plan (p.24‑25)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Gender gaps in digital literacy may limit women’s ability to enroll via the DSR and receive digital payments.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Design gender‑responsive interfaces; provide community‑based digital literacy sessions; offer assisted enrollment points for women.",
      "evidence": "Gender analysis: women less likely to access digital payments; project plans gender‑responsive DSR (p.42‑43)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Coordination challenges among DSS, FD, DWA, MoWCA may cause duplication or gaps in service delivery.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a high‑level inter‑ministerial steering committee with clear terms of reference; hold monthly coordination meetings.",
      "evidence": "Implementation Arrangements: multiple agencies and MoUs required (p.15‑16)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC) manual may not be ready when an emergency occurs, delaying aid.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Finalize CERC manual within six months of effective date; conduct simulation exercises annually.",
      "evidence": "Legal Covenants: CERC manual to be prepared and adopted (p.7‑8)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Reliance on external partners (EU, GIZ) for complementary interventions could be affected by their own funding cycles.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formalize joint work plans with clear deliverables; secure alternative funding sources; monitor partner timelines quarterly.",
      "evidence": "Role of Partners: EU and GIZ provide complementary interventions (p.15‑16)."
    }
  ]
}
